description: Daily, weekly or monthly performance report for a past date: total requests, error rate, p95, top 20 transactions by impact and a timeline. Use to compare days or weeks. A period that has not ended covers only its finished hours (pendingBuckets > 0), and today has no data until it ends; compare such periods per day or use tideways_get_performance_summary. Covers production and the project's default service only; for another environment or service use tideways_get_performance with end and minutes=1440 (one day per call).

date.description: Day to report, "YYYY-MM-DD". For week the API uses the Monday of that week, for month the 1st.

detail.description: "concise" (default) returns a trimmed summary. "full" also includes the unmodified API response under "raw"; it can be very large.

project.description: Tideways project as "project" or "organization/project". Defaults to the defaultProject that tideways_list_projects reports; call it for valid names.

name: tideways_get_history

dateRange.description: Report boundaries in the organization's local calendar (timeline keys are UTC)

pendingBuckets.description: Hours of the period not aggregated yet (zero-filled by the API, left out); when > 0, report totals cover only part of the period

raw.description: Unmodified Tideways API response; present only when detail is "full".

timeline.description: Hourly (UTC) for a day; daily (UTC date, max p95) for a week or month. The first and last days can be partial because the report follows the organization's calendar

transactionCount.description: Transactions in the full report; only the top 20 by impact are listed, detail "full" has all under raw.transaction_report

memoryMax.description: Peak memory in KB (same scale as traces' memoryKb)

title: Get historical report
